name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 5 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2026-05-01, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
